defects.description: PR-v5 flipped hipAbductR from +10 to -10 using the INVERTED (old) sign convention. Per CORRECTED convention, + = ADDUCTION (inward/cross) and - = ABDUCTION (outward/spread). Original +10 was CORRECT for crossing ankle inward. PR-v5 fix made right leg abduct outward — opposite of intended cross.

Description says near arm drapes along column surface. leftShoulder=-8 puts arm abducted only 32° (near-neutral, at side). leftWrist y=0.030 (hip level). Arm should be raised along column to chest/shoulder height.

regression_risk: low — hipAbduct sign revert matches description; shoulder raise is single-pose
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: hipAbduct + = adduction (inward/cross), - = abduction (outward/spread). Description says Cross one ankle over the other → crossing ankle moves INWARD → hipAbductR should be POSITIVE (+10). PR-v5 used inverted convention and made it worse. Reverting to +10. Also: leftShoulder -8 → -45 raises the near arm to ~62° abduction so the wrist reaches chest height for draping along column. leftElbow 40 → 30 for slight bend matching drape (less acute). hipAbductL=+10 already correct (crossing ankle inward).
